killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) declares every file carrying a third-party provenance marker, as vendored or as first-party with a reason
why: hypot.ts, the file #771 found missing, names V8 but has no copyright line, so a marker narrowed to V8's copyright wording would miss the next port like it. The narrowing is visible only through the exemptions: touch.ts and baseline/run.mjs mention V8 and nothing else, so they would match no marker, and an exemption no marker needs is stale.
